IMMIGRATION

Designated Employers – Altona/Rhineland

The employers listed below are officially designated under the Altona/Rhineland Rural Community Immigration Pilot (RCIP). Designated employers are eligible to:

Hire foreign skilled workers from outside Canada, or

Support current employees on temporary status in applying for permanent residency.

Important Information for Foreign Skilled Workers

This list is updated regularly

As more employers receive designation, they will be added here. If you’re currently working in Altona or Rhineland, you may ask your employer to apply for designation. Please note, this is entirely voluntary—employers are not obligated to participate.

Designation does not mean current job openings

Some employers may be designated only to support existing employees and may not be hiring new staff at this time.

Apply only if you are fully qualified

Please do not apply for positions unless you meet all the listed qualifications. Applying for jobs you are not eligible for wastes both your time and the employer’s resources.

Location matters

Only job offers located within the Town of Altona or the Municipality of Rhineland are eligible under the RCIP.
Positions outside this area are not valid for the program—even if offered by a designated employer.
